summary: Vitalik 提交 EIP-8288，为 frame 交易新增一种 frame 类型，让交易把后量子签名和 STARK 声明为“依赖”，由 mempool 和 builder 用一个递归 STARK 替换，从而在后量子时代以低 gas 支持签名与隐私证明。frame 交易的 recent roots 引用（EIP-8272）合并为 Draft。forshtat 清理旧 AA 相关标准：ERC-7562（ERC-4337 验证规则）提交移至 Review，EIP-2542 以被 EIP-8141 取代为由提交撤回。

items.topic: 后量子时代的 frame 交易
items.title: 新 EIP：用于后量子签名和 STARK 聚合的 frame 类型
items.note: （vbuterin）提交，Magicians 讨论帖 05:15，即 EIP-8288。交易可以把签名和 STARK（用于隐私或 L2 等）声明为“依赖”，mempool 和区块 builder 可以把它们替换成一个证明这些依赖全部存在的递归 STARK。
items.title_en: New EIP: Frame Type for PQ Sig and STARK Aggregation
items.note_en: (vbuterin), submitted, with a Magicians thread at 05:15; this is EIP-8288. Transactions can declare signatures and STARKs (for privacy or for L2s) as "dependencies", which the mempool and block builder can replace with a recursive STARK proving that they all exist.

items.note: 提交：GSN 多年未开发，但仍在部分链上使用（包括 Polygon 上的 Polymarket），作者认为不宜撤回。
items.note_en: Submitted: GSN has not been developed for years but is still used on some chains (including by Polymarket on Polygon), so the author did not think withdrawing it made sense.

items.title: EIP-8268：空存储根编码为空字符串
items.note: （CPerezz）提交并合并。此前存储树为空的账户也要在 BAL 中携带 32 字节的空树根，而一个区块中被修改的账户大多是只改余额的 EOA，改为空字符串可以减小 BAL。
items.title_en: EIP-8268: encode empty storage root as empty string
items.note_en: (CPerezz), submitted and merged. Previously an account with an empty storage trie still had to carry the 32-byte empty trie root in the BAL, while most accounts changed in a block are EOAs that only change balance; an empty string makes BALs smaller.

keywords_en: EIP-8288 frame type for PQ sig and STARK aggregation
EIP-8272 recent roots for frame transactions
summary_en: Vitalik submitted EIP-8288, a new frame type that lets a transaction declare post-quantum signatures and STARKs as "dependencies" that the mempool and builder replace with one recursive STARK, supporting signatures and privacy proofs cheaply in a post-quantum world. Recent root references for frame transactions (EIP-8272) were merged as a Draft. forshtat cleaned up older AA related standards: ERC-7562 (the ERC-4337 validation rules) was submitted for Review, and EIP-2542 was submitted for withdrawal as superseded by EIP-8141.
